title: The rest of the talk's lab, on one contact sheet
tries: One still per piece, each the piece's own last frame, so the editor can see the talk's remaining animated pieces at once and choose which deserve their own pages. Where the register says a figure may not be printed, it is masked in the frame itself; a piece still being checked is an empty slot.

question: Is a contact sheet a good way to choose? Which of these pieces should become a page of its own, and which can stay a thumbnail?
